data.title: Michael Howell Says 2026 Won't Be A Big Year For Bitcoin, Sees 30-Year Yield Going Higher
data.description: Speaking on 30-year yields, Michael Howell said that he sees yields rising to 6%, leaving the economy to depend on refinancing.
